Same builder, voice, look, quiz and speaking practice as long-stop-saying-very-v1; changed: only the packaging target (phrase in the title, first description line, first spoken sentence). The 'tired' beats are the approved beats of the long Stop Saying Very videos, word for word.

beats.speech: Looking for another word for tired? Here are ten, from a little tired to very tired. Each one comes with a picture and an example. Let's start.

beats.label: a little tired
beats.speech: Part 1. Five words for a little tired and low on energy.

card.headline: Sleepy
card.example: The children were sleepy after the long drive.

beats.speech: Sleepy. It means tired and ready to sleep. The children were sleepy after the long drive.

card.headline: Drowsy
card.example: This medicine can make you drowsy.

beats.speech: Drowsy. It means tired and almost asleep. This medicine can make you drowsy.

card.headline: Sluggish
card.example: I always feel sluggish after a big lunch.

beats.speech: Sluggish. It means slow and without energy. I always feel sluggish after a big lunch.

card.headline: Lethargic
card.meaning: having no energy and not wanting to do anything

beats.speech: Lethargic. It means having no energy and not wanting to do anything. The heat made everyone lethargic.

card.headline: Groggy
card.meaning: sleepy and not able to think clearly
card.example: I felt groggy after a long nap.

beats.speech: Groggy. It means sleepy and not able to think clearly. I felt groggy after a long nap.

card.headline: Which word fits?
card.question: This medicine can make you ___, so don't drive.
card.answer: This medicine can make you drowsy, so don't drive.

beats.speech: Which word fits? This medicine can make you blank, so don't drive. Drowsy or furious? | This medicine can make you drowsy, so don't drive.

card.headline: Which word fits?
card.question: I always feel ___ after a big lunch.
card.answer: I always feel sluggish after a big lunch.

beats.speech: Which word fits? I always feel blank after a big lunch. Sluggish or tiny? | I always feel sluggish after a big lunch.

card.headline: Repeat after me
card.sentences:
The children were sleepy after the long drive.
This medicine can make you drowsy.
I always feel sluggish after a big lunch.
The heat made everyone lethargic.
I felt groggy after a long nap.

beats.speech: Now say them out loud with me. | The children were sleepy after the long drive. | This medicine can make you drowsy. | I always feel sluggish after a big lunch. | The heat made everyone lethargic. | I felt groggy after a long nap.

beats.label: very tired
beats.speech: Part 2. Now five stronger words, for very tired.

card.headline: Exhausted
card.meaning: so tired you have no energy left
card.example: I was exhausted after the marathon.

beats.speech: Exhausted. It means so tired you have no energy left. I was exhausted after the marathon.

card.headline: Drained
card.example: I felt drained after a long meeting.

beats.speech: Drained. It means tired in body and mind. I felt drained after a long meeting.

card.headline: Worn out
card.example: We were worn out after moving house.

beats.speech: Worn out. It means tired from hard work. We were worn out after moving house.

card.headline: Shattered
card.example: She was shattered after a night shift.

beats.speech: Shattered. It means extremely tired. She was shattered after a night shift. This one is British and informal.

card.headline: Weary
card.meaning: tired after doing something for a long time
card.example: They were weary after a long journey.

beats.speech: Weary. It means tired after doing something for a long time. They were weary after a long journey.

card.headline: Which word fits?
card.question: After the marathon, I was ___.
card.answer: After the marathon, I was exhausted.

beats.speech: Which word fits? After the marathon, I was blank. Exhausted or thrilled? | After the marathon, I was exhausted.

card.headline: Which word fits?
card.question: Three hours of meetings left me ___.
card.answer: Three hours of meetings left me drained.

beats.speech: Which word fits? Three hours of meetings left me blank. Drained or elated? | Three hours of meetings left me drained.

card.headline: Repeat after me
card.sentences:
I was exhausted after the marathon.
I felt drained after a long meeting.
We were worn out after moving house.
She was shattered after a night shift.
They were weary after a long journey.

beats.speech: Now say them out loud with me. | I was exhausted after the marathon. | I felt drained after a long meeting. | We were worn out after moving house. | She was shattered after a night shift. | They were weary after a long journey.
Quick tip: whenever you need another word for any word, look it up on another word for dot net.

card.headline: Which word was new to you?

beats.speech: That's ten words. Which one was new to you? Write it in the comments, and try using it today.
